title: Shogo 1.12
intro: The 1.12 release brings a built-in code editor with AI chat, big improvements to publishing your apps, and a smoother billing and usage experience.

highlights.title: Local Shogo IDE
highlights.description: Edit your project in a full code editor with an AI chat that understands your files.

highlights.title: Publish apps from local
highlights.description: Publish an app directly from the desktop app in local mode.

highlights.title: Server-backed published apps
highlights.description: Run published apps with durable data, always-on servers, and password protection.

highlights.title: Tech stacks at project creation
highlights.description: Pick your stack when creating a project to get started faster.

highlights.title: Smoother billing and usage
highlights.description: Track usage and remaining credits with a unified, live-updating experience.
